PASS — no S-001 blockers found.

Evidence:

- Canonical versions: [setup-callisto.sh](/private/tmp/callisto-release-recovery/.github/actions/setup-callisto/lib/setup-callisto.sh:17) accepts only three canonical decimal components, including `0`, while rejecting leading-zero forms. Both exact requests and resolved latest tags use this validator.
- Prerelease/build handling: rejecting `1.2.3-alpha` and `1.2.3+build` matches S-001’s closed `latest|X.Y.Z|callisto@X.Y.Z` vocabulary. Tests cover bare, tagged, and latest paths at [test_resolver.sh](/private/tmp/callisto-release-recovery/.github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_resolver.sh:146).
- Local WASM freshness: [setup-callisto.sh](/private/tmp/callisto-release-recovery/.github/actions/setup-callisto/lib/setup-callisto.sh:189) builds with explicit `--crate-type cdylib`, `pdk`, `wasm32-wasip1`, and `--release` into a new temporary target directory, then copies only that directory’s artifact.
- Regression coverage: [test_resolver.sh](/private/tmp/callisto-release-recovery/.github/actions/setup-callisto/tests/test_resolver.sh:197) seeds a stale checkout artifact, verifies the isolated target and full Cargo invocation, and proves missing or failed builds cannot install output.
